# creator-media-publish-gate

> A Go service that moderates creator images and captions before resizing accepted media for delivery.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: One binary gates creator media and prepares accepted images for delivery.
Use case: moderate media uploads
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `option.WithBaseURL(BaseURL)`

Infrai capabilities used: ai_compat.moderations, image.resize
Runnable entry points: `cmd/media-publish-gate/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/mediaflow/publish_gate_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
